overview_description.description: First Mills specializes in milling and manufacturing a range of flour products, including wheat derivatives, bran, and animal feed. The company combines traditional milling practices with modern processing techniques to deliver a consistent portfolio of grain-based goods. It operates with a focus on efficiency, food safety, and product variety to meet the demands of industrial, commercial, and consumer markets.

about_short_description.short_description: First Mills specializes in milling and producing various flour products, focusing on customer convenience.

product.name: Bakery Flour
product.description: Flour with 80% extraction rate from wheat, suitable for various bread types including samoli and toast.

product.name: Coarse Semolina
product.description: Semolina made from durum wheat, rich in protein and gluten, ground to a coarse texture for ideal consistency.

product.name: Very Fine Semolina
product.description: Very finely ground semolina from durum wheat, providing a smooth and uniform texture.

product.name: Super Fine Bran Flour
product.description: Bran flour high in fiber, protein, iron, and essential vitamins, suitable for whole wheat bread baking.

product.name: Cattle Fattening Feed Cubes
product.description: Compound feed cubes designed for camels, sheep, goats, and cattle to support nutrition and production.

product.name: Premium Bran Flour
product.description: Bran flour with 80% extraction rate, mixed with semolina grains, suitable for traditional Saudi dishes.
